title: Practice: Getting Closest Matching Ancestors
prompt: Build a nested component and use getting closest matching ancestors to update only the related element. Include a nested edge case so the traversal scope is tested.
objective: Apply getting closest matching ancestors in a controlled example and demonstrate expected behavior with a small test.
